Fed & Policy Watch
  • The Federal Reserve Board marks Wed Nov 11 as Veterans Day and states daily and weekly statistical releases scheduled for today will be released Thu Nov 12. The November Board schedule lists H.15 at 4:15 PM and H.4.1 at 4:30 PM on Nov 12; no market hours or exchange schedule were inferred from the holiday notice.
  • PPI is scheduled Fri Nov 13 at 8:30 AM ET, distinct from the elapsed CPI release on Tue Nov 10. Retail sales is Tue Nov 17 at 8:30 AM ET. The next policy decision and press conference in checked calendars are Dec 9 at 2:00 PM and 2:30 PM ET, respectively.
  • Liquidity and rate context: SOFR 3.88% effective Nov 9, NFCI -0.459 for week ending Oct 30, MOVE 92.43 on Nov 10, and official 10-year Treasury close 4.98% on Nov 10. NFCI and SOFR are lagged observations, not live funding measures.
  • Energy and supply watch: EIA petroleum report is listed Thu Nov 12 at noon; natural-gas storage is Fri Nov 13 at 10:30 AM, with EIA identifying a Veterans Day schedule exception.
Omissions and Watch
  • Checked sources show no remaining timed event today at the cutoff. The date-only Veterans Day holiday is shown separately. Elapsed CPI, Nov 6 Employment Situation and other past releases are not repeated as upcoming catalysts.
  • Conflict check: New York Fed and BEA calendars agree on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM for GDP second estimate and Personal Income/Outlays; BEA supplies Q3 2026 and October 2026 periods. New York Fed separately lists PPI Nov 13 and earlier CPI Nov 10. Census confirms October retail sales Nov 17 and October residential construction Nov 18; NAR pages confirm October existing-home sales Nov 12 and October pending-home sales Nov 18.
  • BLS dates/times are sourced from the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar; bls.gov was not requested. Periods are stated only where a checked primary source supplies one. H.4.1 and H.15 are selected Fed statistical releases, not an exhaustive list.
  • Calendar coverage is selected, not exhaustive: routine Board statistical releases, other Census series, regional surveys, and Treasury bill auctions beyond the listed Nov 12 offerings are omitted. Chicago Fed's checked release calendar lists its National Activity Index on Nov 23, but the checked entry did not supply a time, so no timed row is shown. The EIA petroleum schedule did not state a reporting period in the returned entry.
  • Classifier unmatched rows (Veterans Day holiday, Initial Claims, Weekly Economic Index, SCE Credit Access Survey, Imports and Exports, and Industrial Production) are provisional Medium and explicitly flagged. No overrides used; self-test passed. Treasury bills and 30-year coupon are kept distinct in both names and impacts.
  • No verified unscheduled geopolitical or policy watch item from this run; this is not a full headline-risk review. No CME contract-hours or settlement details were verified. Recheck event notices, liquidity and intended contract specifications before execution.
  • Primary sources checked: New York Fed November Economic Indicators Calendar, SOFR API and Empire State Survey; Federal Reserve Board November and December calendars, FOMC calendar and H.4.1; BEA release schedule; Census 2026 indicator calendar; NAR existing/pending home-sale schedules; Philadelphia Fed MBOS calendar; Chicago Fed NFCI data and release calendar; TreasuryDirect auctions and U.S. Treasury daily yield curve; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules. Snapshot quote source is Yahoo Finance single-source daily/overnight chart data; observation times and prior daily bars are stated above.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Overnight ES is 0.64% above Tuesday's completed daily bar, while SPY's Tuesday close slipped 0.37%; treat the overnight indication as provisional rather than broad-market confirmation. VIX is 19.46, MOVE 92.43 (moderate uncertainty), and the 10-year yield rose 10 bp to 4.98%. With Veterans Day and selected data/auction catalysts close ahead, expect event- and liquidity-sensitive two-way risk; monitor rates, breadth and depth rather than extrapolating the overnight move. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if rates or the upcoming PPI/retail data sharply reprice policy expectations, volatility expands against the overnight move, or ES advances/declines without confirmation from breadth, rates or depth. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify fresh quotes, current event notices and the intended contract before execution.
